evals.prompt: There is a Rigol DHO804 on the bench at 192.168.1.44. Identify it, capture CH1 with 2000 points to /tmp/ch1.csv, and tell me the Vpp and frequency.
evals.expected_output: Runs idn with --host, confirms family rigol, runs capture with --points 2000 --out /tmp/ch1.csv --json, and reports Vpp and frequency from the JSON.
assertions: Uses the idn command with the given host
Uses capture with --points 2000 and --out /tmp/ch1.csv
Reports Vpp and frequency from the capture output

evals.prompt: In WSL, my Tektronix TBS1102B shows up in usbipd as Not shared. Get it working, capture one acquisition, and tell me the waveform type and THD.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor to see the usbipd state, explains the bind and attach steps, then runs capture --single with analysis and reports the waveform type and THD.
assertions: Runs doctor and reads the WSL usbipd section
Explains usbipd bind and usbipd attach
Uses capture --single
Reports waveform type and THD

evals.prompt: I have an intermittent 5 us glitch on CH1 and it happens once every few minutes. Set up a capture that watches for 60 seconds and saves evidence when it fires.
evals.expected_output: Uses monitor with a pulse-width preset or explicit pulse trigger, sets duration and max-events, writes CSV and JSON evidence, and explains the re-arm option.
assertions: Uses the monitor command
Configures a pulse or edge trigger with a short timebase
Sets duration and max-events
Writes evidence files

evals.prompt: Take a screenshot of the scope and save it as scope.png. It is connected over USB.
evals.expected_output: Tries shot; if the model has no screen dump, explains the fallback waveform plot and gives the SVG path instead of claiming a screenshot.
assertions: Uses the shot command
Does not claim a screenshot when the instrument returns no image
Reports the waveform-plot fallback when present

evals.prompt: Here is a CSV I exported earlier: /tmp/run.csv. Give me the FFT, the THD, the harmonics, the overshoot, and the noise level.
evals.expected_output: Runs analyze --csv /tmp/run.csv --fft (and optionally --plot), then reports fundamental, THD, harmonics, overshoot, and noise RMS.
assertions: Uses analyze with --fft
Reports fundamental frequency and THD
Reports harmonics and overshoot or noise

evals.prompt: What frequency and waveform type are on CH1 and CH2 right now? They look identical to me.
evals.expected_output: Captures both channels with analysis enabled and reports frequency, Vpp, duty, and the classified waveform type for each channel.
assertions: Captures CH1 and CH2
Reports frequency and waveform type for both channels
Compares the two channels

evals.prompt: Set the timebase to 5 us/div, trigger on CH1 rising at 1.5 V in normal mode, then take one acquisition and analyze it.
evals.expected_output: Runs timebase, trigger, and capture --single in that order, then reports the analysis.
assertions: Sets the timebase before the capture
Sets the trigger source, slope, level, and mode
Uses capture --single
Reports the analysis

evals.prompt: My ZLG ZDS5054 answers *IDN? but every waveform command fails. Can this skill capture it?
evals.expected_output: Explains that no public SCPI manual was found for ZLG, that the skill identifies the device and uses generic commands, and suggests the scpi command or a vendor tool instead of inventing commands.
assertions: Identifies the family as zlg or generic
States that the waveform command is not documented
Does not invent vendor commands
Offers scpi or a vendor tool as the fallback
